summary: Busy main road kerb beside a paddock, no-stopping signed, no parking.

drivers.seclusion: Vacant paddock behind the kerb and no homes within 40 m, but the stop is on a busy arterial.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs straight to a footpath and grass strip; a van would stand in the lane edge.
drivers.traffic: Wide arterial with centre line, junctions at both ends and a motorway close by at the east.
drivers.convention: Two No Stopping Any Time signs; no cars parked on this side and no parking lane.

sun_shade: Open; no tree cover over the kerb.
